environment.browser: Codex in-app Chromium on local macOS
environment.source: local Vite development build, full assets loaded
environment.begin: first wheel contact at about 13.31 simulation seconds

method: Within the same loaded page, reset and advance the real Race to the same first wheel contact and restore the same camera pose. Replay five seconds with original tree/shadow/refraction rendering, then with optimized rendering. The temporary profiling handle and rendering overrides were removed afterwards. The paired replay predates the final distant-color correction; the final smooth silhouette proxies were checked separately at the viewport recorded below.
limits: Short local desktop samples, not an all-device FPS guarantee.
No physical Android/iPhone, thermal or battery acceptance in this run.
Triangle snapshots include main and transmission passes, not shadow geometry work.
CPU work and rAF times are not GPU timing or power measurements.
The earlier exploratory 41–44 FPS samples had additional test-window contention; they are not the paired baseline.
